messages:
maria (Docs): Heads-up: I opened PR #4890 to update audit-logs doc with redaction hooks, TTL examples (ISO durations), and SDK samples (Go + Ruby). Need security + legal review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4890
josh (Security): Thanks. Two things: SOC2 phrasing for custody + evidence; and mention that redaction doesn't remove archived backups immediately. Paste proposed sentence?
maria (Docs): Proposed: "Redwood retains audit logs per customer-specified retention settings; export and deletion requests are processed, subject to lawful holds and regulatory requirements." Thoughts?
sam (Legal): Prefer "processed" ". Add "subject to lawful holds and regulatory requirements." Also avoid "customer-specified" in some public copy; "customer-defined" reads clearer.
maria (Docs): Updated to: "Redwood retains audit logs per customer-defined retention settings; export and deletion requests are processed, subject to lawful holds and regulatory requirements." Will push.
mina (DevEx): I'll add Go + Ruby snippets. Do we want to show redaction flag in the export API? We have `redact=true` param.
ryan (Eng): Yep API v1 now uses /v1/audit/export and method is client.Audit.Export in Go SDK (PascalCase). Pagination returns next_page_token.
emma (QA): Quick note: include a sample of a redacted JSONL line so customers know schema.
maria (Docs): Adding example JSONL: ```jsonl
{"timestamp":"2025-02-01T10:00:00Z","event":"file_upload","user":"acct_9","redacted":true}
```
mina (DevEx): Go example:
```go
import (
  "fmt"
  redsdk "github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk"
)

client := redsdk.NewClient("TOKEN")
params := map[string]string{"since":"2025-01-01","format":"jsonl","page_size":"200","redact":"true"}
for chunk := range client.Audit.Export(params) {
  fmt.Println(string(chunk))
}
```
Ruby example:
```ruby
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['TOKEN'])
client.audit.export(since: '2025-01-01', format: 'jsonl', page_size: 200, redact: true) do |chunk|
  puts chunk
end
```
ryan (Eng): Minor: in Go snippet show that Export(params) returns a channel; ok as-is. Also add comment about ISO TTL: use `P90D` sample instead of "3 months".
maria (Docs): Added TTL note and migration note for v0.8 -> v0.9 SDK method name changes. Pushed commit. Sam/Josh can you approve wording?
sam (Legal): Approved, one tiny nit: replace "customer-specified" with "customer-defined" (done).
josh (Security): LGTM. Also add line about backups & legal holds in the export caveats section.
maria (Docs): Done, added caveats and a short troubleshooting note for large exports (restart with page_token). Merging after CI. Thanks all :rocket:
